findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_auth_check, spf_watch_subscribe, web_extract_preview, ai_visibility_order · Private data: spf_check, mta_sts_check, dmarc_report_destination_check, dmarc_check, email_auth_check, mcp_discovery_check, spf_watch_subscribe, ai_visibility_order, audit_order, roster_order · Public sink: dmarc_report_destination_check, email_auth_check, mcp_discovery_check, spf_watch_subscribe, ai_visibility_order · Destructive: audit_order, roster_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_auth_check, spf_watch_subscribe, web_extract_preview, ai_visibility_order · Private data: spf_check, mta_sts_check, dmarc_report_destination_check, dmarc_check, email_auth_check, mcp_discovery_check, spf_watch_subscribe, ai_visibility_order, audit_order, roster_order · Public sink: dmarc_report_destination_check, email_auth_check, mcp_discovery_check, spf_watch_subscribe, ai_visibility_order · Destructive: audit_order, roster_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
